def process(requests):
    import pandas as pd
    df = requests.copy()
    # Ensure numeric
    df['Total Helicopter Requests'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Total Helicopter Requests'], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
    # Exclude non-NICC geographic areas / non-area rollups
    exclude = {
        'National Interagency Coordination Center',
        'Other',
        'Canada'
    }
    df = df[~df['Region'].isin(exclude)]
    # Take max
    top = df.sort_values('Total Helicopter Requests', ascending=False).head(1)
    return top
